subject: Post-discovery: ML/Infra technical session scheduling for Stellarus AI
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@stellarus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: ML/Infra technical session scheduling for Stellarus AI

Hi Alicia —

Great to meet the Stellarus team this morning. Quick recap and a proposed next step so we keep momentum:

Recap (very high level)
- Primary objective: run production-quality LLM inference behind Stellarus’s privacy boundary for realtime recommendations.
- Main constraints: MLP infra must be able to meet 75ms p95 latency on 512-token average, and data cannot leave their VPC.
- Key evals: token-cost profile, KV cache behavior for sessionized traffic, and failover path to smaller model variants.

Next step: technical working session with our ML/Infra engineers (60–90 minutes). Goal: align on architecture, run a short demo of model serving, and agree acceptance criteria for pilot.

Proposed agenda (60–90m)
1) 10m — Introductions / goals and constraints
2) 20m — Architecture walk (network, security, data flow)
3) 25–40m — Live demo: serving runtime + KV cache example + perf numbers
4) 10–15m — Acceptance criteria, next steps, owners

Please confirm:
1) Who from Stellarus should be on the call (infra, security, product)?
2) Which of these windows works in PT?
   - Wed Sep 6: 10:00–11:30 PT
   - Thu Sep 7: 14:00–15:30 PT
   - Fri Sep 8: 08:00–09:30 PT

I’ve attached a short post-discovery notes PDF and a one-sheet of what we’ll demo. If you prefer, we can do a shorter 60m run with a focused demo — say 15m demo + 30m deep dive.

Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: post-discovery-notes.pdf
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@stellarus.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Sep 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: ML/Infra technical session scheduling for Stellarus AI

Thanks, Ben — really helpful recap.

Quick answers:
- Attendees: me (Head of Product), Daniel Park (Infra Lead, daniel.park@stellarus.ai), and two folks from Security (sec-lead@stellarus.ai). I’ll confirm the exact names tomorrow.
- Windows: Thu Sep 7 14:00–15:30 PT looks best for us.

We definitely want the infra lead and security on the call — the VPC/KMS pieces are gating for our procurement. Could you confirm whether you’ll demonstrate a VPC-connected flow or a simulated network topology? Also, do you have a short preread for the security team (SOC2 artifacts, data retention policy)?

If Thu works, we’ll block our calendars pending invites.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Product, Stellarus AI
alicia@stellarus.ai

Perfect — thanks for confirming, Alicia. Thursday Sep 7 14:00–15:30 PT is reserved on our side for a 90-minute slot. I’ll tentatively schedule for 14:00–15:30 PT and send an invite once we lock attendees.

To answer the security questions:
- Demo network setup: we’ll show a simulated VPC-connected flow (we can demonstrate a private endpoint + KMS flow in the demo environment). For customers who want full VPC peering in a later step, we bring a dedicated Private deployment checklist.
- Prereads: I’m attaching a short Security cheat sheet (SOC2 highlights + retention matrix) and a short mutual action plan outline. I’ll also add our Security contact for the session.

Marissa — looping you and Marcus in: can you own demo ownership and walk the KV cache + perf numbers? Marissa, Marcus — please add any prep items you want the customer to complete beforehand (sample traffic shape, a small dataset, or IAM roles).

Alicia — can you confirm Daniel Park’s email and the security lead names so I can include them on the invite? Once Daniel’s confirmed we’ll send a formal calendar invite + a short prep checklist.

Linking the HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-7862

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
